$description: Explicit, checked-in correspondence between MDS token names (src/tokens.ts / src/semantic-tokens.ts) and Figma variable names (file uWlcofRor5Dik8LBnJbIjo). Replaces the previous convention of one-off '★ Figma anchor' comments — those record THAT a token was verified against Figma at some point, not WHAT it corresponds to, so nothing could ever re-check them automatically. Every entry here was confirmed live via the Figma MCP's get_variable_defs (not guessed, not carried over from a comment alone) — see 'verifiedVia' on each entry.
$schema_note: figmaVariable is the exact Figma variable name as returned by get_variable_defs (Figma's own '/'-hierarchy naming, e.g. 'V3/Surface/Primary') — deliberately NOT renamed to match MDS's camelCase convention; the two naming languages stay separate, this file is the bridge between them, not a rename of either side.
status: partial — seeded with only what has been live-verified so far, see README below
readme: Only 1 of the 25 '★ Figma anchor'-commented primitives in tokens.ts (gold750) has ever had its specific Figma variable recorded — the other 24 just say '★ Figma anchor' with no Figma-side name captured, because the anchor comment convention only ever recorded THAT a check happened, not the variable name itself.

Live component-instance queries (Button node 7579:138, SideNavigation node 7584:41118) only ever surfaced semantic/role-tier 'V3/*' variables, never primitive-scale ones directly — real components in this Figma file consume semantic variables, not raw primitives, so primitive-tier correspondences may need a different discovery approach (e.g. a node from the Primitive Colors page itself, not a component instance) in a future pass.

Do not add entries to this file by guessing a plausible Figma name — every entry must come from an actual get_variable_defs (or equivalent) query result. An unmapped token is better than a wrong mapping nobody will think to double-check.
